settings.title: Contact Soliseed Support
settings.content: Need help choosing a grow light, setting up your product, or finding warranty support? Send us a note and we will point you to the right next step.
settings.text_1_text: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-5:00 PM Pacific Time. Most messages receive a reply within 1-2 business days.
settings.text_2_text: For shipping status, returns, refunds, or order changes, please use your Amazon order page first. For setup or warranty questions, include your Amazon order ID when you contact us.
